content.text: The nixpkgs bump in your modified `flake.lock` added a typed `nix.settings.experimental-features` option (`list of string`) — it used to be freeform where a space-separated string coerced fine. Fixing all three call sites:

input.command: sed -i 's|experimental-features = "nix-command flakes";|experimental-features = [ "nix-command" "flakes" ];|' nixos/common.nix home/home.nix home/agent.nix && grep -rn "experimental-features" --include="*.nix" .

content.text:
Both home-manager configs now evaluate cleanly. The NixOS build got past evaluation (it's been running >10 min compiling, not erroring out) — I'll confirm when it lands.

**What happened:** your `flake.lock` bump pulled in a nixpkgs where `nix.settings.experimental-features` became a properly typed option (`list of string`). It used to be part of the freeform `nix.conf` attrset, where the space-separated string `"nix-command flakes"` was accepted verbatim. Now it's type-checked, and a string is rejected.

**Fix** — `[ "nix-command" "flakes" ]` in all three places that set it:

- `nixos/common.nix:19` (the one that failed)
- `home/home.nix:64`
- `home/agent.nix:59`

The last two hadn't errored yet because home-manager's `nix.settings` is still freeform, but they'd have hit the same wall on the next home-manager bump, and the list form renders identically in `nix.conf` either way.

Nothing else in the tree sets that option, so this is the whole change.

content.text: Build's still compiling; the eval fix is what mattered and that's confirmed. Committing now — splitting into two so neither commit leaves the tree broken (the list form is valid on the old nixpkgs too, so the fix can land first):

input.command:
git add nixos/common.nix home/home.nix home/agent.nix && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
fix(nix): pass experimental-features as a list, not a space-joined string

nixpkgs now declares nix.settings.experimental-features as a typed
option (list of string) rather than leaving it to the freeform nix.conf
attrset, so the space-separated string form is rejected:

  A definition for option `nix.settings.experimental-features' is not of
  type `list of string'.

The list renders identically in nix.conf. home-manager's nix.settings is
still freeform, but home.nix and agent.nix get the same treatment so they
don't hit this on the next bump.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/REDACTED
EOF
